client/src/pages/ServiceDetail.tsx.name: Service detail page
client/src/pages/ServiceDetail.tsx.description: Shows one supervised service with its health, recent restarts and the controls to start or stop it.

client/src/pages/Services.tsx.name: Services list
client/src/pages/Services.tsx.description: Lists the services the platform supervises and whether each one is healthy.

client/src/pages/Settings.tsx.name: Settings home
client/src/pages/Settings.tsx.description: Gathers every settings area in one place, from branding and sign-in to AI models and retention.

client/src/pages/settings/AIBehaviorSett.name: AI behaviour settings
client/src/pages/settings/AIBehaviorSett.description: Sets the standing guidance given to every AI assistant and whether it plans its own steps.

client/src/pages/settings/AIEmbeddingSet.name: AI search settings
client/src/pages/settings/AIEmbeddingSet.description: Chooses the service that turns text into searchable meaning so knowledge search works.

client/src/pages/settings/AIModelSetting.name: AI model settings
client/src/pages/settings/AIModelSetting.description: Chooses which AI models are offered, their access keys and prices, and which one is used by default.

client/src/pages/settings/AIUsageSetting.name: AI spend settings
client/src/pages/settings/AIUsageSetting.description: Shows what AI usage has cost and sets the limits on how much is allowed.

client/src/pages/settings/AppSdkUpgradeS.name: App runtime upgrades
client/src/pages/settings/AppSdkUpgradeS.description: Chooses whether published apps quietly pick up improvements to the platform they run on.

client/src/pages/settings/ArtifactRetent.name: Output retention settings
client/src/pages/settings/ArtifactRetent.description: Sets how long the files and reports produced by runs are kept before being removed.

client/src/pages/settings/AuditRetention.name: Audit retention settings
client/src/pages/settings/AuditRetention.description: Sets how long the audit history is kept and what happens when it ages out.

client/src/pages/settings/Branding.tsx.name: Branding settings
client/src/pages/settings/Branding.tsx.description: Sets the product name, logo, colours and wording people see throughout the app.

client/src/pages/settings/GitHub.tsx.name: GitHub settings
client/src/pages/settings/GitHub.tsx.description: Connects the workspace to GitHub so workflows and apps can be versioned and kept in step.

client/src/pages/settings/GitHubConnecti.name: GitHub connection summary
client/src/pages/settings/GitHubConnecti.description: Shows which GitHub account and repository the workspace is connected to.

client/src/pages/settings/GitHubCreateRe.name: Create repository dialog
client/src/pages/settings/GitHubCreateRe.description: Creates a new GitHub repository for the workspace without leaving the settings.

client/src/pages/settings/GitHubDisconne.name: GitHub disconnect prompt
client/src/pages/settings/GitHubDisconne.description: Confirms breaking the link to GitHub and explains what stops being kept in step.

client/src/pages/settings/GitHubResource.name: Repository picker
client/src/pages/settings/GitHubResource.description: Chooses which GitHub organization and repository the workspace should use.

client/src/pages/settings/GitHubTokenFie.name: GitHub access field
client/src/pages/settings/GitHubTokenFie.description: Takes the GitHub access key used to act on the workspace's behalf.

client/src/pages/settings/KubernetesSett.name: Kubernetes settings
client/src/pages/settings/KubernetesSett.description: Connects a Kubernetes cluster so the platform can run its work there, and shows the current state.

client/src/pages/settings/Maintenance.ts.name: Maintenance tools
client/src/pages/settings/Maintenance.ts.description: Groups the upkeep tasks an operator can run, such as rebuilding the search index or scanning app dependencies.

client/src/pages/settings/maintenance/Ma.name: Maintenance action row
client/src/pages/settings/maintenance/Ma.description: Shows one upkeep task with its button and the outcome of running it.

client/src/pages/settings/maintenance/Ma.name: Maintenance results
client/src/pages/settings/maintenance/Ma.description: Shows what an upkeep task found or fixed, including anything that needs follow-up.

client/src/pages/settings/MCP.tsx.name: AI assistant settings
client/src/pages/settings/MCP.tsx.description: Sets up the connections that let AI assistants look things up and act inside the platform.

client/src/pages/settings/MCPConnectionD.name: AI connection details
client/src/pages/settings/MCPConnectionD.description: Shows the details of one AI assistant connection.

client/src/pages/settings/MCPResetDialog.name: AI connection reset prompt
client/src/pages/settings/MCPResetDialog.description: Confirms resetting an AI assistant connection and warns that its current setup is lost.

client/src/pages/settings/MCPToolPicker..name: AI tool picker
client/src/pages/settings/MCPToolPicker..description: Chooses which tools an AI assistant connection is allowed to use.

client/src/pages/settings/MemorySettings.name: Memory switch
client/src/pages/settings/MemorySettings.description: Chooses whether the platform remembers useful context between conversations.

client/src/pages/settings/OAuth.tsx.name: Company sign-in settings
client/src/pages/settings/OAuth.tsx.description: Connects company sign-in providers so people can use the work account they already have.

client/src/pages/settings/oauth/OAuthPro.name: Sign-in provider card
client/src/pages/settings/oauth/OAuthPro.description: Shows one company sign-in provider with its state and the fields needed to set it up.

client/src/pages/settings/oauth/OAuthRea.name: Sign-in settings error
client/src/pages/settings/oauth/OAuthRea.description: Says the company sign-in settings could not be loaded.

client/src/pages/settings/oauth/Preferre.name: Preferred sign-in
client/src/pages/settings/oauth/Preferre.description: Chooses which sign-in method people are offered first on the login screen.

client/src/pages/settings/RequiredInstru.name: Required instructions
client/src/pages/settings/RequiredInstru.description: Sets guidance every agent must follow, without editing each agent's own instructions.

client/src/pages/settings/RunRetentionSe.name: Run history retention
client/src/pages/settings/RunRetentionSe.description: Sets how long run history and its logs are kept before being cleared away.

client/src/pages/settings/SettingsReadEr.name: Settings load error
client/src/pages/settings/SettingsReadEr.description: Says a settings section could not be loaded and offers to try again.

client/src/pages/settings/workflow-keys/.name: Workflow key dialogs
client/src/pages/settings/workflow-keys/.description: Creates, reveals once and revokes the keys that let outside systems start a workflow.

client/src/pages/settings/workflow-keys/.name: Workflow keys list
client/src/pages/settings/workflow-keys/.description: Lists the keys that can start workflows, with when each was created and last used.

client/src/pages/settings/WorkflowKeys.t.name: Workflow keys page
client/src/pages/settings/WorkflowKeys.t.description: Manages the keys outside systems use to start workflows without a person signing in.

client/src/pages/Setup.tsx.name: First-run setup
client/src/pages/Setup.tsx.description: Guides the very first administrator through creating their account on a brand-new install.

client/src/pages/SolutionDetail.tsx.name: Solution detail page
client/src/pages/SolutionDetail.tsx.description: Shows one Solution's contents, versions and installations, with the controls to deploy or update it.

client/src/pages/Solutions.tsx.name: Solutions list
client/src/pages/Solutions.tsx.description: Lists the packaged sets of workflows, forms, agents and apps that install in one step.

client/src/pages/solutions/SolutionCount.name: Solution contents count
client/src/pages/solutions/SolutionCount.description: Shows how many workflows, forms, agents and apps a Solution brings with it.
